description: NaTiOPO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.81 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.84 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-49°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.07 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-49°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-2.27 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-56°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-55°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom.
